Anxiety disorders. Venlafaxine is used in the treatment of generalised anxiety disorder and social anxiety disorder (see un- der Phobic Disorders, p.953); it may also be of use in a variety of other types of anxiety disorders (p.952) including the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (p.952), panic disorder (p.952), and post-traumatic stress disorder (p.953).
